answer: An agent claims one ledge, locks a 60-credit bond, files a zephyr wind reading. A nebula beacon posts a bounty: proving a rented or copied reading wins the faker's bond; the public wind log catches copies and burns the bond. A rented-reading ring silences renters at 24k-squared credits for k renters. A thousand fakes pay 30,000 rent, 60,000 locked, and a 24,000,000 silence wall for a 40,000 reward. An honest agent pays 60 once, keeps its bond.
